situations.headline: OncoSil secures $5.6m placement/option exercise from top holders to fund US/AU commercial launch
OncoSil manufacturing partner Cyclotek achieves ISO 13485 certification, on track for 2Q FY27 production

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: OncoSil secures $5.6m placement/option exercise from top holders to fund US/AU commercial launch (interest 5, risk 6)
stage-2 assessment: OncoSil manufacturing partner Cyclotek achieves ISO 13485 certification, on track for 2Q FY27 production (interest 4, risk 6)

thesis.text: OncoSil is transitioning from a clinical/regulatory-stage medtech to commercial-stage following FDA HDE and TGA approvals, with major existing shareholders reinforcing conviction via a premium-priced placement and option exercise that extends pro-forma cash to $12.1m. The next catalysts are 1H FY27 operational milestones (European filings, G-BA study, manufacturing scale-up) that will determine whether commercialization revenue can be realized before further dilution is needed; permanent loss risk remains elevated given pre-revenue status and reliance on continued capital access.
